exact_values: Zero Filling and Persistent Free Subgroups of the Figure-Eight Knot (v1.0): negative answer to the literal universal OWR2020 question; zero torus-bundle filling kills a nontrivial word in every rank-two free subgroup, while all rational filling groups are infinite.
